debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (EMA 50/200, SMA 50/200, ADX trending, Supertrend bullish) remains intact with price near support (332.56), offering contrarian opportunity in fear-driven market (VIX crisis regime).
debate.key_bear_argument: Short-term momentum completely absent (RSI9 oversold without confirmation, price below all key moving averages, MACD/AO/OBV/CMF all negative), zero fundamental conviction (no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, high earnings risk in 62 days), and macro environment unfavorable (VIX 295.2 crisis) make this a low-probability swing entry despite long-term bullish structure.
